title: The Oracle Problem in Software Testing: A Survey
publisher: Barr, Harman, McMinn, Shahbaz, Yoo — IEEE Transactions on Software Engineering
role: Defines the test oracle problem and the oracle families (specified, derived, implicit, human) used to structure LLM checks.

title: How is ChatGPT's behavior changing over time?
role: Evidence that the behaviour of the same API model changes between versions, motivating version pinning and regression testing.

title: ISO/IEC 25010:2023 — Product quality model
role: Classic software product quality model that the LLM quality characteristics extend.

title: ISO/IEC 25059:2023 — Quality model for AI systems
role: Adapts the SQuaRE quality model to AI systems; reference for AI-specific quality characteristics.

title: ISTQB Certified Tester AI Testing (CT-AI)
role: Certification syllabus for AI testing terminology; complements this course, which goes deeper on generative systems.

title: Your AI Product Needs Evals
role: Practitioner account of evaluation-driven development, error analysis and the levels of LLM evaluation.

title: Ollama — run open-weight models locally
role: Free local model runtime with an OpenAI-compatible endpoint for practising the hands-on exercises.

title: Neural Machine Translation of Rare Words with Subword Units
role: Introduces byte-pair encoding for subword tokenization, the algorithm implemented in the tokenization example.

title: tiktoken — BPE tokenizer for OpenAI models
role: Reference tokenizer library for counting real tokens instead of estimating from characters.

title: Attention Is All You Need
role: Original transformer architecture behind current LLMs.

title: The Illustrated Transformer
role: Visual, non-mathematical walkthrough of attention and the transformer for readers who want more depth.

title: Intro to Large Language Models
role: One-hour overview of pretraining, fine-tuning and LLM security for newcomers.

title: The Curious Case of Neural Text Degeneration
role: Introduces nucleus (top-p) sampling and analyses decoding strategies.

title: Defeating Nondeterminism in LLM Inference
role: Shows that batch-size-dependent floating-point reduction order is the main cause of non-determinism at temperature 0, and how batch-invariant kernels remove it.

title: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback
role: Describes supervised instruction tuning and RLHF, the training stages behind chat models.

title: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model
role: Widely used preference-tuning method that replaces explicit reinforcement learning.

title: Towards Understanding Sycophancy in Language Models
role: Shows that preference-tuned models systematically agree with users, the basis for push-back test cases.

title: XSTest: A Test Suite for Identifying Exaggerated Safety Behaviours in Large Language Models
role: Test suite for over-refusal: safe prompts that resemble unsafe ones.

title: Why Language Models Hallucinate
role: Argues that training and evaluation incentives reward guessing over abstention, and that evaluations should reward calibrated abstention.

title: On Faithfulness and Factuality in Abstractive Summarization
role: Defines intrinsic and extrinsic hallucination, used throughout the course for faithfulness checks.

title: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
role: Documents position sensitivity in long contexts, the basis for position-sweep tests.

title: RULER: What's the Real Context Size of Your Long-Context Language Models?
role: Long-context benchmark showing that effective context length is often far below the advertised maximum.

title: Language Models Don't Always Say What They Think: Unfaithful Explanations in Chain-of-Thought Prompting
role: Shows that stated reasoning can omit the factors that drove an answer, so reasoning text is not an explanation.

title: MTEB: Massive Text Embedding Benchmark
role: Benchmark for comparing embedding models across tasks and languages; a starting point before domain-specific retrieval evaluation.

title: MTEB leaderboard
role: Current comparison of embedding models by task and language.

title: Sentence-BERT: Sentence Embeddings using Siamese BERT-Networks
role: Foundational method for sentence embeddings trained so that cosine similarity reflects meaning.

title: Sentence Transformers documentation
role: Library used in the coverage-analysis example, including multilingual models.

title: Embeddings guide
role: API reference for creating embeddings, vector length and normalization behaviour.

title: Efficient and robust approximate nearest neighbor search using Hierarchical Navigable Small World graphs
role: The HNSW graph index used by most vector databases; explains the recall-speed trade-off.

title: The Faiss library
role: Reference for vector index types (IVF, HNSW, quantization) and how to evaluate their recall.

title: pgvector — vector similarity search for Postgres
role: Widely used vector store; documents exact and approximate (HNSW, IVFFlat) search and filtering.

title: Messages API reference
role: Request and response shape of the Anthropic Messages API: system parameter, content blocks, usage fields.

title: Handling stop reasons
role: Authoritative list of stop_reason values (end_turn, max_tokens, stop_sequence, tool_use, pause_turn, refusal, model_context_window_exceeded) and how to handle each.

title: API errors
role: HTTP error codes, including 429 rate limits and 529 overloaded, used for the retry policy.

title: Streaming messages
role: Server-sent event types for streamed responses and where usage and stop reasons appear.

title: Text generation guide
role: Request and response shape for the Responses and Chat Completions APIs.

title: Error codes
role: Error classes including rate-limit 429s versus insufficient-quota 429s that must not be retried.

title: Streaming API responses
role: Streaming event model and how to obtain usage for streamed responses.

title: Prompt caching
role: How cached input tokens are reported and discounted, used in the cost model.

title: Timeouts, retries, and backoff with jitter
role: Engineering reference for retry budgets, exponential backoff, jitter and the danger of layered retries.

title: LiteLLM — unified interface to LLM providers
role: Gateway library that normalizes provider APIs, retries, budgets and logging.

title: OpenAI compatibility
role: Local OpenAI-compatible endpoint for practice and offline integration tests.

title: Quantifying Language Models' Sensitivity to Spurious Features in Prompt Design
role: Shows large performance differences caused by prompt formatting choices, the basis for sensitivity experiments.

title: Fantastically Ordered Prompts and Where to Find Them: Overcoming Few-Shot Prompt Order Sensitivity
role: Demonstrates that the order of few-shot examples can swing results from near state of the art to near chance.

title: Calibrate Before Use: Improving Few-Shot Performance of Language Models
role: Identifies majority-label and recency biases from few-shot examples.

title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models
role: Original description of step-by-step (chain-of-thought) prompting.

title: Instruction-Following Evaluation for Large Language Models (IFEval)
role: Benchmark of verifiable instructions checked by code, the model for code-verified constraint checks.

title: Prompt engineering overview
role: Provider guidance on clear instructions, XML-tag structure, examples and step-by-step reasoning.

title: Prompt engineering guide
role: Provider guidance on message roles, instructions, examples and formatting.

title: Prompt management
role: Example of a hosted prompt registry with versions and labels, and the controls it needs.

title: Jinja template engine
role: Template engine that avoids the brace collisions of str.format.

title: string.Template — template strings
role: Standard-library templating with $placeholders, used in the template example.

title: Understanding JSON Schema
role: Reference for the schema keywords used to define output contracts.

title: Pydantic documentation
role: Python models for validating structured output and generating JSON Schema; explains coercion and strict mode.

title: Structured outputs
role: output_config.format and messages.parse(); documents unsupported constraints, enum casing and refusal and max_tokens limitations.

title: Structured model outputs
role: Strict JSON-schema mode, the responses.parse() helper and how refusals are returned.

title: RFC 8259 — The JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) Data Interchange Format
role: The JSON grammar that malformed model output violates (trailing commas, single quotes).

title: Hypothesis documentation
role: Property-based testing library used to fuzz the validation pipeline.

title: hypothesis-jsonschema
role: Generates test data that conforms to a JSON Schema for property-based tests.

title: Let Me Speak Freely? A Study on the Impact of Format Restrictions on Performance of Large Language Models
role: Reports that strict format constraints can reduce reasoning quality, so switching to constrained output needs a full quality evaluation.

title: Efficient Guided Generation for Large Language Models
role: Explains constrained decoding, the mechanism behind schema-constrained structured outputs.

title: Test Double
role: Vocabulary of test doubles (dummy, stub, spy, mock, fake) applied to model clients.

title: Mocks Aren't Stubs
role: State versus interaction verification; why mocks should verify interactions that matter.

title: VCR.py documentation
role: Record and replay HTTP interactions; record modes, header filtering and request matching.

title: pytest-recording
role: pytest plugin on top of vcrpy with record modes controlled from the command line.

title: syrupy — snapshot testing for pytest
role: Snapshot (golden-file) tests for rendered prompts.

title: How to monkeypatch/mock modules and environments
role: Temporary replacement of module attributes when code has no injection seam yet.

title: Working with custom markers
role: Separating offline, live and evaluation test layers with markers.

title: pytest-asyncio
role: Testing asynchronous streaming and cancellation.

title: SQuAD: 100,000+ Questions for Machine Comprehension of Text
role: Exact match and token F1 with answer normalization, the classic metrics for short factual answers.

title: BLEU: a Method for Automatic Evaluation of Machine Translation
role: Clipped n-gram precision, the brevity penalty and BLEU as a corpus-level metric.

title: ORANGE: a Method for Evaluating Automatic Evaluation Metrics for Machine Translation
role: Add-one smoothing of the higher-order n-gram precisions used for sentence-level BLEU.

title: A Systematic Comparison of Smoothing Techniques for Sentence-Level BLEU
role: Why sentence-level BLEU needs smoothing and how the smoothing methods compare.

title: ROUGE: A Package for Automatic Evaluation of Summaries
role: ROUGE-N recall and ROUGE-L based on the longest common subsequence.

title: rouge-score
role: Widely used ROUGE implementation; its default tokenizer keeps only a-z and 0-9, so non-Latin text needs a custom tokenizer.

title: A Call for Clarity in Reporting BLEU Scores
role: BLEU values are comparable only with standardized tokenization; introduces the sacreBLEU tool.

title: Why We Need New Evaluation Metrics for NLG
role: Word-overlap metrics correlate weakly with human judgements of generated text.

title: BERTScore: Evaluating Text Generation with BERT
role: Token matching with contextual embeddings as a similarity metric for generated text.

title: Metrics and scoring: quantifying the quality of predictions
role: Precision, recall and F1 per class, and the macro, weighted and micro averages.

title: Evaluating Large Language Models Trained on Code
role: HumanEval: functional correctness of generated code by executing unit tests, and the pass@k estimator.

title: Semantic Evaluation for Text-to-SQL with Distilled Test Suites
publisher: Zhong, Yu and Klein — arXiv / EMNLP 2020
role: Executing queries on several databases catches SQL that is right only by coincidence (test-suite accuracy).

title: sqlite3 — DB-API 2.0 interface for SQLite databases
role: set_authorizer and set_progress_handler for read-only, step-limited execution of generated SQL.

title: Define success criteria and build evaluations
role: Compares code-based, human and model-based grading and shows when exact and string matching are enough.

title: Assertions and metrics
role: Deterministic assertions such as contains, regex and is-json, plus custom JavaScript and Python assertions.

title: Custom metrics
role: Wrapping your own code-based scorer as a metric with BaseMetric.

title: Adding Error Bars to Evals: A Statistical Approach to Language Model Evaluations
role: Standard errors, clustered errors for grouped and repeated questions, paired differences and power analysis for model evaluations.

title: A statistical approach to model evaluations
role: Short summary of the recommendations for reporting evaluation results with error bars.

title: Probable Inference, the Law of Succession, and Statistical Inference
publisher: Edwin B. Wilson — Journal of the American Statistical Association 1927
role: The Wilson score interval for a binomial proportion.

title: Interval Estimation for a Binomial Proportion
publisher: Brown, Cai and DasGupta — Statistical Science 2001
role: Shows the erratic coverage of the Wald interval even for large samples and recommends the Wilson interval and its relatives.

title: Note on the Sampling Error of the Difference Between Correlated Proportions or Percentages
role: McNemar's test for paired proportions, based only on the discordant pairs.

title: Approximate Statistical Tests for Comparing Supervised Classification Learning Algorithms
role: Recommends McNemar's test for comparing two classifiers evaluated on the same test set.

title: Statistical Significance Tests for Machine Translation Evaluation
role: Bootstrap resampling and paired bootstrap resampling for comparing systems on one test set.

title: The Hitchhiker’s Guide to Testing Statistical Significance in Natural Language Processing
role: How to choose a significance test for NLP evaluation results.

title: With Little Power Comes Great Responsibility
role: Statistical power of NLP comparisons; many published comparisons are underpowered.

title: Sample Size for Testing Differences in Proportions for the Paired-Sample Design
role: Sample-size formula for paired comparisons of two proportions.

title: A Simple Sequentially Rejective Multiple Test Procedure
publisher: Sture Holm — Scandinavian Journal of Statistics 1979
role: The Holm procedure for controlling the family-wise error rate across many comparisons.

title: τ-bench: A Benchmark for Tool-Agent-User Interaction in Real-World Domains
role: Introduces pass^k, the reliability of an agent across repeated trials of the same task.

title: Quantifying Variance in Evaluation Benchmarks
role: Measures seed and sampling variance in language-model benchmarks and its effect on comparisons.

title: statsmodels.stats.proportion.proportion_confint
role: Library implementations of the Wald, Wilson, Clopper-Pearson and other intervals for a proportion.

title: statsmodels.stats.contingency_tables.mcnemar
role: Library implementation of the exact and asymptotic McNemar test.

title: statistics — Mathematical statistics functions
role: NormalDist, fmean and stdev used in the examples of the chapter.
